meta.snapshot_convention: Each snapshot uses a unique id and matching timestamp: id = YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMSS_short_slug (24h clock, no colons in id); timestamp = same instant as ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (sortable, distinguishes multiple updates on one day).
